args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+ recommended)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations, flight tickets)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Reusable water bottle
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers for electronic devices
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (if not renting)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip flops/sandals

Activities to consider when packing:
- Beach day at Waikiki Beach
- Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay
- Hiking at Diamond Head
- Visit to Pearl Harbor
- Road trip to the North Shore
- Luau experience at Polynesian Cultural Center
- Relaxation day at hotel spa
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach
- Shopping at Ala Moana Center
